description: Inspect application errors, projects, releases, and stability data in Bugsnag. Review error, release, and stability context to assess impact and support defect triage, release reviews, and remediation follow-up. For engineering and operations teams, the available context supports organizing information around an environment, resource, or issue. Use it in investigation records and maintenance plans to clarify the next checks and coordination priorities. Available data and operations depend on the current connection configuration, account permissions, and service plan.
description_cn: 在 Bugsnag 中查看应用错误、项目、版本发布和稳定性数据。适合结合错误、版本和稳定性信息梳理问题影响，为缺陷分流、发布回顾和修复跟进提供依据。面向研发与运维团队，可围绕具体环境、资源或问题整理相关信息，将分散的运行背景用于排查记录与维护计划，帮助团队明确后续核查和协作重点。具体可用的数据与操作范围以当前连接配置、账号权限及服务套餐为准。
